_about: Files to delete once the new build (pieces from equations, region data, Shape Map, then the view built from the pieces) checks out. Nothing here is deleted yet. See PURGE.md.

keep.working_data.py: builds the working data (the single verified source)
keep.edges_from_equations.py: wall edges and cuts from the equations
keep.pieces.py: wall pieces built from equations, edges and cuts
keep.piece_regions.py: regions beside each piece; regions' walls (full/partial), lines, points
keep.optimal_seeds.py: seeds and the surface library (to be untangled, see below)
keep.place_colors.py: colour rule, also imported by research/tetraswirl_atlas/build_page.py

scripts.probe.py: classifier _one → cell_atlas2.identify/load_refs, classify, classify_fast, cellframe, catalog, cell_atlas
scripts.t2_pieces.py: extended() group, but imports region_cells/region_walls/wall_sections at load
scripts.arrangement.py: surfaces() — builds the surface library from fexact_* files and the old page
scripts.region_walls.py: page_data() — reads the old Symmetry Domain page
scripts.exact_defs.py: made exact_defs.json from meshes (edge_curves/edge_display/xsurfaces.json); freeze its output, retire the script
